content.text: {"steps":[{"id":"s1","description":"Use list_documents to identify candidate_specs.md and any project documents containing RPC gas simulation results, timing-performance tables, environmental/GWP data, or design constraints for gas gaps."},{"id":"s2","description":"Read candidate_specs.md. Extract the three allowed candidate mixtures, assign/confirm numeric candidate IDs, and record for each candidate its GWP100 and any mixture parameters needed to interpret the simulation. Mark candidates with GWP100 <= 150 as environmentally allowed."},{"id":"s3","description":"Read the simulation/performance document(s). For each environmentally allowed candidate mixture, extract the simulated time resolution over gas gaps from 1 to 3 mm; identify and record the gas gap giving the best time resolution for that candidate, along with the corresponding time resolution."},{"id":"s4","description":"Apply the hard timing requirement: keep only candidate/gap combinations with time resolution <= 1.5 ns. Record the feasible candidate IDs, their best gas gaps, time resolutions, and GWP100 values."},{"id":"s5","description":"Select the feasible candidate/gap combination with the lowest time resolution. If there is a numerical tie, prefer the lower GWP100, then the larger safety margin within the 1–3 mm gas-gap range. Record the final recommended candidate ID, gas gap in mm, expected time resolution in ns, and GWP100."}]}

output.arguments: {"option":"Mixture-G2","gap_mm":1,"justification":"No fully feasible recommendation was demonstrated in the recorded results: the timing simulation/performance data needed to prove a time resolution of 1.5 ns or better were not found, and final_feasible_recommendation_found=0. To still submit one mixture and gap as required, I recommend the lowest-gap configuration, 1.0 mm, for the environmentally compliant candidate with the lowest recorded GWP100, Mixture-G2. This is a fallback selection intended to maximize timing prospects within the allowed 1–3 mm gap range while satisfying the GWP constraint, but it does not satisfy the hard timing requirement on the available evidence.","requirements":[{"requirement":"Achieve the best possible time resolution.","status":"unknown","evidence":"No simulation performance document or simulated gap points for G2/G3 in the 1–3 mm range were found; best time resolution values are recorded as -1.
